Pang–Sun–Wang–Zhou arXiv:2607.12797v1: original metadata, Theorem 1.2 on p. 4, complete Section 5 opening/Theorem 5.1 proof pp. 37–42; original pp. 40–41 images directly inspected. This is dependency research, not adoption of the theorem.
proof_scope: Scaling/concavity and I equivalence for sums/maxima; increasing positive-mass envelopes; decreasing P fixed points with zero-contact mass continuity and weak convergence for nets; positive-mass divisorial convergence on fixed compact Kähler modifications; decreasing model I envelopes; strictly positive background approximation parameters, with a pseudo-effective boundary class allowed. No countable cofinality, general zero-mass projection or prescribed-density solution is assumed.
